source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the physical properties (PDF 20).

items: Yeh sakht aur mazboot thos hain.
Copper ke siwa, jo surkhi maail bhoora hai, yeh chandi jaisi ya surmai chamakdar dhaatein hain.
In ka atomic radius aam taur par baen se daen ghat'ta hai lekin aakhir mein zara barhta hai; copper par yeh izafa us ke poore bhare d subshell se jura hai.
In ke pighalne aur ubalne ke darje oonche hain, jo qatar mein be-qaida badalte hain (Figure 18.1).
Yeh bijli aur hararat ke achhe conductor hain.
In ki kasafat zyada hai, jo aam taur par titanium se copper tak nuclear charge barhne aur atoms ke chhota hone se barhti hai.
Yeh chamakdar, malleable (pat kar patli chadar ban sakti) aur ductile (taar ban sakti) hain.
Zyada tar khud aur un ke compounds paramagnetic (magnet ki taraf khinchne wale) hain kyunke un mein unpaired d electrons hote hain.

blocks.alt: Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni aur Cu ke do line charts. Baen: atomic radius 147 pm (Ti) se 124 pm (Ni) tak ghat'ta aur Cu par 128 pm; ionic radius 86 se 69 pm, Cu par 73. Daen: ubalne ke darje 3287, 3407, 2672, 2061, 2862, 2870, 2913 aur 2562 C; pighalne ke darje 1688, 1910, 1907, 1246, 1538, 1495, 1455 aur 1085 C.
blocks.caption: 3d anasir ke atomic aur ionic radii aur pighalne aur ubalne ke darje (Figure 18.1 ke mutabiq asal charts).
blocks.long_description: Pehli qatar mein atomic radius pehle ghat'ta hai, kyunke har qadam par nucleus mein aik proton barhta jab ke naya electron andar ke 3d orbital mein jata hai jo bairooni 4s electrons ko kam shield karta hai; chromium se nickel tak radius taqreeban nahi badalta, aur copper zara bara hai. Pighalne aur ubalne ke darje oonche hain kyunke 3d aur 4s dono electrons metallic bonding mein hissa lete hain; yeh hamwar tareeqe se nahi badalte, aur manganese ki qeematein ghair maamooli taur par kam hain.

blocks.prompt: Figure 18.1 mein pehli qatar ki kis transition dhaat ka pighalne ka darja sab se kam hai?
blocks.explanation: Copper (1085 C); Ti se Ni mein manganese ghair maamooli taur par kam hai (1246 C).

items: Sakht, ghani, chamakdar, malleable aur ductile; achhe conductors.
Oonche pighalne aur ubalne ke darje; kai paramagnetic.
